en: Greetings, |PLAYERNAME|. What are you doing out here?

I understand your scepticism, but believe me, all will be well! As you can see, they change colour from dark to light red, and that's when they also start turning soft. <stirs with one hand while he slices carrots and peppers with the other hand> ...
translated: Разумем ваш скептицизам, али верујте ми, све ће бити добро! Као што видите, мењају боју из тамне у светлоцрвену и тада почињу да постају мекане. <stirs with one hand while he slices carrots and peppers with the other hand> ...

en: Now we just have to let it simmer and stir using a blessed wooden stake <stirs so vigorously that you can barely see his arms anymore> for thirty minutes. ...
translated: Сада само треба да пустимо да крчка и мешамо помоћу благословљеног дрвеног колца <stirs so vigorously that you can barely see his arms anymore> тридесет минута. ...

en: Here we go! <pounds with his bare hands on the steak> This will break through the meat fibres, making our steak more tender for this fine Daramanian dish. ...
translated: Идемо! <pounds with his bare hands on the steak> Ово ће пробити месна влакна, чинећи наш бифтек мекшим за ово фино дарамско јело. ...

en: Okay! So after all of these heavy dishes, we're going to create a fast little snack. <starts preparing the peppers as he speaks> ...
translated: ОК! Дакле, после свих ових тешких јела, направићемо брзу малу ужину. <starts preparing the peppers as he speaks> ...

en: Aah, so let's see! <prepares the food quickly while he explains it to you> We cook the meat in a large pot together with the chopped onion until it's separated from the bones. Now we also have a fine meat broth! ...
translated: Ааа, па да видимо! <prepares the food quickly while he explains it to you> Месо кувамо у већем лонцу заједно са сецканим луком док се не одвоји од костију. Сада имамо и фину месну чорбу! ...

en: Welcome to the {explorer society} headquarter of Svargrond, |PLAYERNAME|!
So, which profession would you give preference to when enchanting the helmet: {knight}, {sorcerer}, {druid} or {paladin}?
translated: Дакле, којој професији бисте дали предност када очаравате кацигу: {knight}, {sorcerer}, {druid} или {paladin}?

translated: У реду... договор је договор, да ли желите да направим {spool of yarn} од {10 pieces of spider silk}?

translated: Поздрав, путниче |PLAYERNAME|. Где желиш да ја {fly} тебе?

en: You are probably talking about the {FEMOR hills}.
Welcome to the Horn of Plenty, |PLAYERNAME|. Sit down, have a {drink} or some {food}!
translated: Добродошли у Рог изобиља, |PLAYERNAME|. Седите, узмите {drink} или нешто {food}!
